source_family: Official Binance USD-M daily metrics; newly observed futures positioning rather than an alternative transformation of the existing 60 inputs

official_api_context.historical_api_retention: latest one month; use archives for this three-year study
official_api_context.top_trader_definition: users in the top 20% by margin balance, not a demonstrated high-skill or profitable cohort

new_information.open_interest: stock of open futures positions and changes in outstanding exposure; absent from the current price/spot-flow/premium/funding features
new_information.positioning_ratios: account and position crowding; not equal to signed net market ownership
new_information.taker_ratio: futures aggressor flow, distinct market from existing spot flow but potentially correlated

research_interpretation: Incremental predictive value must be assessed using identical observation populations and models, not assumed from novelty.
Dollar open-interest value partly reflects price mechanically; fixed new features use quantity changes.
time_availability_limitations: Nine checksum-verified representative files all used labels from 00:00 through 23:55; the queried ETH June24/25 pair had no shared label. A publicly reported June25 timing change was not reproduced by these label samples and is not treated as established.
Timestamp labels alone cannot establish measurement windows or earliest API availability.
Each asset had 871 of 1099 archive objects last-modified more than two calendar days after its file date. Last-Modified is current object publication/revision metadata, not original API availability.
Using record_ms+10 minutes and requiring available age in [0,5 minutes) is a conservative research assumption, not point-in-time provenance or a guarantee against all historical revisions.
quality_policy: Publisher SHA256 first; exact 5-minute UTC clocks; sort observed records; positive finite numeric fields; all conflicting same-time rows discarded; no interpolation or fabricated observations.
